description: Unlimited Cities - Rennes Gare Sud is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by UFO Urbanisme Collaboratif. city without Limit Rennes The Open Data data of Unlimited Cities/Rennes Gare Sud contains the results of the choices made by the participants during the experimentation and manipulation of the Unlimited Cities application on the Rennes Gare Sud site. Coverage: UFO Urbanisme Collaboratif. The publisher named on the listing is UFO Urbanisme Collaboratif. Its keywords include rennes, collaboratif, participation, urbanisme. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2016-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
